nom: StriVectin Multi-Action Clear Daily Brightening & Retexturizing Toner

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin report the toner helps balance sebum and reduce oiliness without increasing breakouts, with several calling it their best toner for this skin type.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin report the toner does not strip, tighten, or dry out their skin, and one with dry, dull skin reports smoother, softer, hydrated results.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin, including those with an oily T-zone, report smaller-looking pores, brighter skin, and control of oiliness and acne marks.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers describing sensitive, reactive, or dermatitis-prone skin mostly report the toner is gentle and non-irritating, though one reviewer with oily sensitive skin experienced itching and inflamed bumps after full-face use.
segments.mature: Reviewers who identify as older or mature (including ages 44 and 78) report the toner helps with texture, brightening, and lingering acne without drying their skin.

concerns.aging: Mature reviewers link the toner to improved texture and a healthier, more youthful-looking glow alongside its acne benefits; no reviewer reports it targeting fine lines or wrinkles directly.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers state the toner does not dry out or strip skin and instead leaves it feeling hydrated, soft, or smooth; one reviewer found it drying when paired with the rest of the set's cleanser.
concerns.redness: A few reviewers report reduced redness, inflammation, or calming of irritated skin, but one reviewer reports the toner itself caused their face to turn bright red.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers generally report no irritation, no purging, and a formula described as not disrupting the skin barrier; one reviewer disagrees, reporting itching and inflamed bumps after applying to the full face.
concerns.spots: Many reviewers report fading of dark spots, discoloration, post-acne marks, and more even skin tone after several days to weeks of use; one reviewer reports no improvement in acne spots or dark spots.
concerns.blemishes: The large majority of reviewers, including several with acne-prone or hormonal acne, report fewer breakouts, calmer active pimples, and reduced blackheads/clogged pores; a notable minority (including two 1-star and one 2-star review) report no improvement or worsened acne, including new cystic-type bumps and increased oiliness.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin generally report the toner helps balance oil production and leaves skin hydrated without greasiness, though one reviewer reports it made her skin too oily and caused more clogged pores.

aspects.libelle: Disliked new fragrance versus old formula
Small product sizes may not last 30 days
Perceived high price relative to benefit

extraits.texte: This was recommended to me by one of the workers at Ulta because I was willing to try a new toner. I heard good comments about this toner, and the worker told me it would be nice for me since I have oily skin. I used it one night, about an hour later, I noticed my face and my neck started to itch, like a lot, and it was really weird to me cause that never happened to me before because I follow the same night routine and the only difference was the new toner. Then I woke up from that night and notice like small kind of inflamed bumps on my cheeks and I knew it was from the toner. So I would be highly cautious about this, it might work for a lot of people, probably not just for me. Disclaimer, I did do a test patch and didn't seem to react too badly, but putting it on the entire face was different experience.

extraits.titre: Did not work for periodic acne nor hormonal acne
extraits.texte: Unfortunately I did not like this acne line. I love Strivectin and normally use their moisturize & C serum. I was out of my original products and decided to try this new one from Strivectin. I've tried this acne line for 6wks with comparison pictures and it made my acne worse. I agree it doesn't not dry out the skin, but beyond that it did not offer me benefit. Cons: didn't stop new breakouts or active breakouts, developed more clogged pores (white heads even on cheeks), made me too oily Pros: did not dry out skin, products gentle on skin I usually use a liquid exfoliant with salicylic acid. Then a benzoyl peroxide treatment. It seemed to work good enough for my hormonal and causal breakouts thru my cycle. I was disappointed Strivectin Acne line did not agree with my skin.

I have re purchased this toner because it is both effective and gentle. Works well for areas of oiliness and pimples on my combination skin. It is not harsh for the areas that are more sensitive. I use other Strivectin products and they are top shelf. I am 78 and have been using skincare products of all kinds for years but I always repeat on Strivectin.

I have oily, acne prone, red skin. Every toner I've ever used has made me more oily and clog my pores, but not this one. I've been using this toner in my morning routine for two months now and my skin is clear and even in color. I've noticed how bright my skin is recently and I couldn't believe how well this toner has been working

extraits.titre: Seems to be okay for sensitive skin
extraits.texte: I love using a toner in my routine, but I recently stopped because I was diagnosed with seborrheic dermatitis (flaking dry skin) so I simplified my routine to reduce dry out. I gave this a try for a few days though and it didn't irritate my very sensitive skin. It also has a nice smell. Id recommend this if you're looking for a decently non aggressive toner. Gifted by strivectin.

I have searched for a toner that does not dry my skin and does not cause outbreaks. This is it. I used it throughout the summer and because it is non drying looking forward to using it through NY winters

I'll love this three-step system. It comes with a face wash, a toner, and a moisturizer. I struggle with acne around my time of month, and I have noticed that this helps with any breakouts. I tend to use it at night all together. I've noticed that it isn't harsh on my skin, and I typically have very sensitive and dry skin. So far, I'm really enjoying this!
